Wrong option A reuses a wrong option of the earlier question M2-S20-T2. Both say: implement the code first and add the tests only afterwards. The two questions also have the same correct actions: write the test suite before implementation, then share the failing tests.

blind_answer.reason: Test-driven iteration (3.5-K2/S2): write tests first that cover expected behavior, edge cases such as zero-weight parcels, and the 50 ms limit. Then share the specific test failures after each attempt so every iteration has concrete, measurable feedback instead of 'still wrong'.
